name: Pink Floyd

whyMatters.en: London band formed in 1965. After Syd Barrett’s early psychedelic singles, the Waters/Gilmour years produced long-form concept albums; The Dark Side of the Moon (1973) and The Wall (1979) are the main commercial references.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦乐队，1965 年成立。Syd Barrett 早期迷幻单曲之后，Waters/Gilmour 时期推出长篇概念专集；《The Dark Side of the Moon》（1973）与《The Wall》（1979）是主要商业参照。

note.en: From The Dark Side of the Moon; clock sound effects, rototom figure, then verse/chorus and Gilmour solo.
note.zh: 出自《The Dark Side of the Moon》；钟声效果、rototom 音型，再接主副歌与 Gilmour 独奏。

note.en: Title track from Wish You Were Here; acoustic guitar and shared vocal focus.
note.zh: 同名专辑标题曲；原声吉他与人声为主。

note.en: From The Wall; Waters verse, Gilmour chorus, two guitar solos.
note.zh: 出自《The Wall》；Waters 主歌、Gilmour 副歌，两段吉他独奏。

interviewQuotes.text: The purpose of the music is to free people.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Roger Waters

interviewQuotes.text: It's not about being loud. It's about being there.
interviewQuotes.speaker: David Gilmour

lyricQuotes: The child is grown, the dream is gone
We're just two lost souls swimming in a fish bowl

shortBio.en: London progressive / psychedelic rock, 1965–. Barrett then Waters/Gilmour; Dark Side and The Wall are the core concept-album references.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦 progressive / 迷幻摇滚，1965 年至今。Barrett 之后是 Waters/Gilmour；《Dark Side》与《The Wall》是核心概念专集参照。

body.en:
Pink Floyd formed in London in 1965. Early singles center on Syd Barrett. After Barrett left, David Gilmour joined; the 1970s catalog under Waters’ writing includes The Dark Side of the Moon, Wish You Were Here, Animals, and The Wall—studio effects, spoken samples, and album-length song cycles.

Time (1973) and Comfortably Numb (1979) show clock-effect arrangement and dual-vocal/solo structure. Waters left after 1985; later albums led by Gilmour form a separate chapter. Mason remains the only member present from the start.
body.zh:
Pink Floyd 于 1965 年在伦敦成立。早期单曲以 Syd Barrett 为中心。Barrett 离队后 David Gilmour 加入；1970 年代在 Waters 写作主导下推出《The Dark Side of the Moon》、《Wish You Were Here》、《Animals》、《The Wall》——录音室效果、口语采样与专辑长度歌曲组。

《Time》（1973）与《Comfortably Numb》（1979）展示钟声效果编曲与双人声/独奏结构。Waters 于 1985 年后离队；之后由 Gilmour 主导的专辑是另一章节。Mason 是自始保留的成员。

body.en:
Pink Floyd’s mid-1970s records treat the album as the main unit: long production, sound design, and linked themes.

The Dark Side of the Moon spent years on the Billboard 200. Studio work and large-scale live shows used the same engineering focus.
body.zh:
Pink Floyd 1970 年代中期录音把专辑当作主要单位：长制作、声音设计与贯穿主题。

《The Dark Side of the Moon》在 Billboard 200 停留多年。录音室与大型现场共用同一套工程重心。

body.en:
Early psychedelia is Barrett-centered. The mid catalog is Waters writing with Gilmour on guitar and shared vocals. After 1985, Gilmour-led albums are another legal and musical chapter.

Lineup versions explain both the disputes and the sound shifts.
body.zh:
早期迷幻以 Barrett 为中心。中期目录是 Waters 写作，Gilmour 负责吉他与部分人声。1985 年后 Gilmour 主导专辑是另一法律与音乐章节。

阵容版本同时解释争执与声音转向。

body.en:
Sound-effect intro, rototom figure, verse/chorus, then Gilmour solo. It sits near the middle of Dark Side’s running order.

The track is a clear map of the album’s production method.
body.zh:
音效引入、rototom 音型、主副歌，再接 Gilmour 独奏。曲目靠近《Dark Side》专辑中段。

这首歌清楚标出该专的制作写法。

body.en:
Waters sings a dry verse; Gilmour lifts the chorus. Two guitar solos appear in one song.

It is among the best-known tracks from The Wall (1979).
body.zh:
Waters 唱干的主歌；Gilmour 抬起副歌。一曲内有两段吉他独奏。

这是《The Wall》（1979）最知名的曲目之一。

body.en:
Richard Wright’s harmony pads and Nick Mason’s steady drums underpin the concept years. Vocal and lyric authority shift across albums and are audible on the records.

Who writes the frame changes by era.
body.zh:
Richard Wright 的和声铺底与 Nick Mason 稳健鼓组支撑概念专集年代。人声与歌词权威随专辑转移，在录音上可闻。

谁写框架因时期而变。

body.en:
Later art-rock and ambient-adjacent bands cite the production. Some metal acts cite the album scale. Punk often rejected the spectacle side.

The catalog remains a studio-engineering reference.
body.zh:
后来的 art-rock 与 ambient 邻近乐队引用其制作。部分金属乐队引用其专辑体量。朋克常拒绝其奇观一面。

目录仍是录音室工程参照。

note.en: Syd Barrett–centered psychedelic lineup; early singles period.
note.zh: 以 Syd Barrett 为中心的迷幻阵容；早期单曲时期。

note.en: Concept-album years; Dark Side through The Wall.
note.zh: 概念专集年代；从《Dark Side》到《The Wall》。

note.en: Early Barrett-era UK single; psychedelic period marker.
note.zh: Barrett 时期早期英国单曲；迷幻时期标记。

note.en: Album-length concept production on mass charts in the 1970s.
note.zh: 1970 年代进入大众榜单的专辑长度概念制作。
